parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package, which is clearly under an Examples/SampleApp path. Both records are bare type-alias-object entries with empty fields_or_signature and no name populated, providing no structural evidence of a meaningful shared shape (jaccard, shared_field_count, and shared_ancestor are all null). The collision is therefore a coincidental naming overlap between a debug-panel utility alias in DebugPanel and a sample-app debug HUD alias in Wallpaper's example target, not a refactorable duplication.
